about.title: About GOAT Fence Company
text: GOAT Fence Company helps homeowners across Katy, Cypress, Richmond, Fulshear, and West Houston with wood fence installation, fence repair, fence replacement, wrought iron fencing, and chain link fencing. We keep the process straightforward: clear walkthroughs, honest recommendations, solid workmanship, and a final result that looks right and works the way it should.
